title: Nonprofits & foundations catalog: the philanthropic layer wiring global health, digital identity, AI-safety, and civil-society research
source: Public record: foundation 990s/annual reports; grant databases; ID2020 Alliance founding partners; GAVI/WHO funder disclosures; Open Philanthropy grants DB; OpenAI/Anthropic governance reporting; W3C/NIST/ISO/IEEE identity standards. Catalog layer for the academia/nonprofits epic (#206). Structural overlay; edges graded. HONESTY: documented funding/partnerships are FACT; imputing a single coordinated agenda ('Great Reset control') across independent foundations would be a composition fallacy - programs are named, intent is not asserted.

edges.notes: The Gates Foundation is among the WHO's largest funders (often the #1 or #2 contributor incl. via GAVI) - giving a private foundation outsized agenda-setting weight in global health (fact of funding; influence = interpretation).
The Gates Foundation co-founded GAVI (the Vaccine Alliance, 2000) with a $750M seed - the model of foundation-launched global-health public-private partnerships (fact).

Gates funds digital-identity + digital-financial-inclusion (ID4D with the World Bank; MOSIP open-source ID platform; Mojaloop payments) - a major driver of national digital-ID rollouts in the Global South (fact of programs; 'control' framing contested).
The Rockefeller Foundation co-founded the ID2020 Alliance (2016) to advance digital identity 'for all' - the marquee foundation-led digital-ID initiative (fact).
ID2020's mission is universal digital identity - the alliance node that ties foundations + tech firms to the Digital_ID thread (fact).
Microsoft (with Accenture, GAVI, Rockefeller) was a founding ID2020 partner - the corporate/foundation coalition behind digital identity (fact).
Rockefeller - the century-old template for scientific philanthropy (public health, the Green Revolution) - also backs global-health alliances (fact).
The Wellcome Trust (UK; ~GBP 38B endowment) is a top global-health/biomedical funder alongside Gates - the other pole of private health-research money (fact).
GAVI works alongside the WHO/UNICEF/World Bank on immunization - the public-private-partnership machinery of global health (fact).

The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative (CZI, an LLC not a 501c3) is funded by Mark Zuckerberg's Meta wealth - a founder-controlled 'philanthropy' with for-profit flexibility (science, education, and formerly criminal-justice) (fact).
CZI's biomedical + education-data programs (e.g. Summit Learning) intersect the data-collection/identity debates - a smaller but notable thread (fact of programs; scope graded).
Open Philanthropy (funded by Dustin Moskovitz + Cari Tuna) is the largest Effective Altruism grantmaker - the money engine of the EA movement (fact).
Open Phil gave OpenAI a $30M grant (2017) that came with a board seat - an early EA-aligned foothold in frontier-AI governance (fact).

Anthropic is deeply EA-aligned (founders + early funders incl. FTX/SBF pre-collapse; the Long-Term Benefit Trust governance) - the AI lab most identified with EA/AI-safety (fact of alignment; degree of control graded).
EA-aligned board members were central to the Nov-2023 OpenAI board crisis (the brief ouster of Sam Altman) - the highest-profile case of AI-safety philanthropy colliding with commercial AI (fact).
The Ford Foundation is among the funders of civil-society digital-rights research incl. Citizen Lab's spyware work - the foundation money behind independent surveillance accountability (fact).
Open Society Foundations (Soros) fund digital-rights/civil-society research + advocacy - a major, politically-polarizing civil-society funder (fact of funding; political framing contested).
MacArthur has funded cybersecurity/digital-rights research (incl. Citizen Lab-adjacent work) - part of the foundation ecosystem underwriting surveillance accountability (fact).
The Hewlett Foundation ran a large Cyber Initiative funding cyber-policy + civil-society security research (fact of program).
Omidyar Network (Pierre Omidyar, eBay) funds 'good ID' / digital-identity + civic-tech work - a major private funder shaping the digital-ID debate (fact).
Omidyar + Open Society + Ford frequently co-fund the same digital-rights/independent-media ecosystem - the liberal-philanthropy civil-society cluster (fact of co-funding patterns).

The World Economic Forum promotes digital identity (Known Traveller Digital Identity; decentralized-ID work) as part of its Fourth Industrial Revolution agenda - a convening/agenda-setting node, NOT a governing authority (fact of initiatives; 'control' interpretations contested/overstated).
The W3C standardized Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs) + Verifiable Credentials - the technical backbone of the 'self-sovereign identity' model (fact).
NIST SP 800-63 (Digital Identity Guidelines) sets the US federal identity-assurance standard - the govt-side rulebook that shapes vendor/agency ID systems (fact).
ISO/IEC 18013-5 (mobile driving licence / mDL) is the international standard behind state mobile-ID rollouts - the interoperability layer (fact).
IEEE contributes biometric + identity technical standards feeding the same ecosystem (fact).

Gates + Rockefeller repeatedly co-fund global-health + digital-ID/financial-inclusion initiatives - the two anchor foundations of the modern development-tech agenda (fact of co-funding; unitary agenda NOT asserted).
